text: Given a valid access-token header, When supabase_list_organizations is called, Then it returns the mocked organization list (id/name) verbatim
Given a valid access-token header, When supabase_list_projects is called, Then it returns the mocked project list (ref/name/organization_id/region/status/created_at) verbatim
Given a project ref, When supabase_get_project is called, Then it returns the mocked project detail record
Given a project ref, When supabase_get_project_api_keys is called with no reveal argument, Then reveal=false is passed through and the mocked masked key values are returned unchanged
Given a project ref, When supabase_get_project_api_keys is called with reveal: true, Then reveal=true is passed through and the mocked full key values are returned unchanged
Given a project ref and a SQL statement, When supabase_run_sql is called, Then it POSTs {query} to /database/query and returns the mocked result rows from the 201 response
Given a project ref and an invalid SQL statement, When supabase_run_sql is called against a mocked 400 response, Then a structured invalid_argument error is returned, not a raw exception
Given a project ref and a SQL statement, When supabase_run_readonly_sql is called, Then it POSTs {query} to /database/query/read-only and returns the mocked result rows

Given a project ref and a mutating SQL statement, When supabase_run_readonly_sql is called against a mocked 400 read-only-role rejection, Then a structured invalid_argument error is returned and the connector performs no SQL parsing of its own
Given a project ref, When supabase_list_functions is called, Then each returned function has slug/name/status/version/created_at/updated_at
Given a project ref and a function slug, When supabase_get_function is called, Then it returns the mocked function detail record

Given a project ref, a new function slug, source file(s) and an entrypoint path, When supabase_deploy_function is called, Then it builds a multipart body (file + metadata with entrypoint_path) and returns the mocked created record

Given a project ref and an existing function slug, When supabase_deploy_function is called with the same slug, Then the connector sends the same multipart deploy call (no separate create/update branch) and returns the mocked updated record
Given a project ref, When supabase_list_branches is called, Then each returned branch has id/name/parent_id/is_default/persistent/status
Given a project ref and a branch name, When supabase_get_branch is called, Then it returns the mocked branch detail record
Given a project ref and a branch name, When supabase_create_branch is called, Then it POSTs the branch body and returns the mocked created branch record
Given a project ref and a branch, When supabase_delete_branch is called without confirm:true, Then no call reaches Supabase and the tool returns a confirmation-required error
Given a project ref and a branch, When supabase_delete_branch is called with confirm:true, Then Supabase's DELETE /v1/branches/{id} is called and success is returned

Given a project ref, When supabase_list_secrets is called, Then each returned secret has name/value/updated_at exactly as the mocked response has them, and none of those values appear in any captured log line

Given a project ref and name/value pairs, When supabase_create_secrets is called, Then it POSTs the array body and returns the mocked confirmation; a mocked 400 (reserved SUPABASE_ prefix) surfaces as a structured invalid_argument error
Given a project ref and secret names, When supabase_delete_secrets is called without confirm:true, Then no call reaches Supabase and the tool returns a confirmation-required error
Given a project ref and secret names, When supabase_delete_secrets is called with confirm:true, Then Supabase's bulk DELETE /v1/projects/{ref}/secrets is called and success is returned
Given no X-Supabase-Access-Token header, When any tool is called, Then a structured 401 naming the header is returned and the mocked upstream records zero calls
Given a mocked 401/403 upstream response, When any tool is called, Then a structured error is returned, not a stack trace

Given two concurrent requests with two different X-Supabase-Access-Token values, When each is handled, Then each only sees the mocked response wired to its own token and no shared module-level state is read or written across the two

Given a real free-tier Supabase account, When organizations/projects are listed and one project's details are fetched through the connector, Then the returned records match what the Supabase Dashboard shows
steps: Configure a real Supabase personal access token in the X-Supabase-Access-Token header
Call supabase_list_organizations, supabase_list_projects, supabase_get_project against that account
Open the same account/project in the Supabase Dashboard
expect: Every id/name/ref/status field returned by the tools matches the Dashboard's display for the same account/project
notes: needs a real vendor account; no Supabase credentials are configured in this pipeline's environment (SOP: not a blocker)

text: Given a real Supabase project, When a real read-write SQL statement (e.g. create table) is run via supabase_run_sql and then a select is run via supabase_run_readonly_sql, Then the create is reflected in the Dashboard's Table Editor and the select returns the row
steps: Call supabase_run_sql on a real project with a `create table` / `insert` statement
Confirm the table/row in the Supabase Dashboard's Table Editor
Call supabase_run_readonly_sql with a `select` against the same table
expect: Table/row appears in the Dashboard after the write; the read-only select returns the inserted row
notes: needs a real vendor account; no Supabase credentials are configured in this pipeline's environment (SOP: not a blocker)

text: Given a real Supabase project, When a branch is created and then deleted with confirm:true, Then both are reflected in the Supabase Dashboard
steps: Call supabase_create_branch on a real project
Confirm the branch appears in the Supabase Dashboard
Confirm the branch disappears from the Dashboard
expect: Branch appears after create, disappears after the confirmed delete
notes: needs a real vendor account; no Supabase credentials are configured in this pipeline's environment (SOP: not a blocker)

text: Given a real Supabase project, When a trivial Edge Function is deployed via supabase_deploy_function, Then it appears under Edge Functions in the Dashboard and responds when invoked
steps: Call supabase_deploy_function on a real project with a minimal "hello world" function source
Confirm the function appears under Edge Functions in the Supabase Dashboard
expect: Function appears in the Dashboard and returns a successful response when invoked
notes: needs a real vendor account; no Supabase credentials are configured in this pipeline's environment (SOP: not a blocker)
